{"path": "/root/makefun/pucuys-office-joke-entry/main.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One-Line Office Joke: 24-Hour Sprint (u-pucuys-one-line-office-joke-24-hour-sprint-aaf86162).

Writes one single-line joke about office life (max 200 characters) to
/output/entry.txt. No network, no randomness: every run writes the same
bytes so both graded runs match.
"""
from pathlib import Path

JOKE = (
    "Our HR chatbot sent a calendar invite to schedule a meeting about "
    "reducing meetings. Everyone accepted, including the two people it "
    "was written for: the printers."
)


def main() -> None:
    out = Path("/output")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    line = JOKE.strip()
    assert 1 <= len(line) <= 200, "entry must be 1-200 characters"
    (out / "entry.txt").write_text(line, encoding="utf-8")
    print(line, f"({len(line)} chars)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}
